race.comment: WHISKEY TUMBLER (1) was a most impressive maiden winner over a similar trip at Balaklava three weeks ago. Has always held promise and gets his chance to go right on with the job. CARPE ASTRA (2) knocked off WHISKEY TUMBLER to shed her maiden tag back in March. Meets her a fraction worse at the weights this time but with anticipated improvement during the break, she rates a serious winning hope again here. REOFFER (9) only missed by a head from resuming a big price winner at Murray Bridge. Draws well again and strips fitter. Have to consider. CHARKA (5) returns and makes her stable debut for Wayne Brown. Was a good on-pace winner first-up last campaign over 1000m at Gosford. Will pay to keep an eye on the late money, her NSW form would have a bit on these.
